verdict.rationale: Goodwin's Founders Workbench offers web tools such as Document Driver and the Capital and Liquidation Calculators, and a product of that kind could plausibly ship an SDK, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows any official SDK or developer library, and probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI specs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
